_comment: REFERENCE — fully-annotated compliance policy showing every available field. Not loaded at runtime; the live policy is at public/compliance.json. Comments use the `_comment` key convention (JSON has no native comments).

context._comment: Identifies which KB slice this policy was composed from. Used to filter variants by `product` at runtime and for audit traceability.

documentDefaults._comment: Document-wide typography defaults. Cascade order: element.layout → slotStyles[slot] → container.layout (if inside a sub-container) → block.layout → documentDefaults. First non-empty value wins. Empty strings mean 'inherit from Unlayer body settings'.

documentContainer._comment: Document-wide container defaults. Each block's `container` overrides these per-property. Use four-value padding form ('T R B L') so Unlayer's padding widget round-trips cleanly.

linkConfig._comment: Suffix appended to every external_link href (UTM/tracking). Smart-joined: starts with `?` but switched to `&` if URI already has a query. Not applied to email_link / merge_field / plain. Not applied when user is in Custom override mode.

preview_disclosures._comment: Example: a block with NO sub-containers — all elements rendered as bare divs stacked in one outer wrapper.
preview_disclosures._comment_required: `required: true` shows a TODO triangle on the tile until the block is added to the design. `false` or omitted means optional (no triangle, but still single-instance — block can't be added twice).
preview_disclosures.label: Preview disclosures

layout._comment: Block-level typography. Inherits unset props from documentDefaults.

container._comment: Block-level wrapper styling. Inherits unset props from documentContainer.

slotStyles._comment: Per-slot layout overrides applied during the cascade. Keyed by element.slot.

elements._comment: Minimal element: just one variant, no placeholders.
elements.label: Audience Restriction

variants.text: This is a promotional email, created and funded by Novartis, intended for UK Healthcare Professionals only.

variants._comment: deprecated:true keeps the variant available in the Source dropdown but tags it [dep] in the label.
variants.text: This is a promotional email from Novartis intended for GB Healthcare Professionals.

elements._comment: Element with all four placeholder kinds for reference. `product` on variants filters by context.product — Glivec variant is hidden when context.product === 'Scemblix'.
elements.label: PI Link

layout._comment: Per-element layout override (overrides slotStyles, container, block, document).

kbMeta._comment: Passthrough metadata from the KB — preserved for downstream automation; not rendered.

variants.text: Prescribing information for SCEMBLIX® ▼ (asciminib) can be found {{pi_link}} (external link).
Prescribing information for SCEMBLIX®▼ (asciminib) can be found {{pi_link}}.{{ref1}}

placeholders._comment: plain → just substitutes anchorText (no <a> tag). Good for footnote markers like '1'.

variants._comment: Filtered at runtime: product !== context.product so this variant is hidden from the Source dropdown.
variants.text: Prescribing information for GLIVEC® (imatinib) can be found {{pi_link}}.

elements._comment: Demo: email_link and merge_field placeholder kinds.
elements.label: AE Reporting (demo placeholders)

variants.text: Report to MHRA at {{yc}}, email {{medinfo}}, or click {{unsub}}.

placeholders._comment: email_link → anchorText. `uri` is the bare email address.
merge_field → anchorText. `uri` is a template token replaced server-side (SFMC, Pardot, etc).

regulatory_footer._comment: Example: a block WITH sub-containers — elements are grouped into named boxes via slotRouting.
regulatory_footer.label: Regulatory footer

containers._comment: Named sub-container. Elements whose slot maps to this id (via slotRouting) get wrapped in a div with this container/layout.
containers.label: Highlighted Box

slotRouting._comment: Routes each slot to a container id. `null` means render outside any container.

legal_footer._comment: Example: a block with logo (BDS asset reference) and approval code (MLR document reference).
legal_footer.label: Legal footer

logo._comment: BDS asset reference. Editor shows a dropdown of all assets matching assetTag. Selected assetId is resolved to URL at render. URL is NEVER stored in the policy.

approvalCode._comment: MLR document reference. When mlrDocumentId is null, renders fallbackPlaceholder. When set, render-time fetch resolves the actual code (read-only — author cannot edit).
